bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
p="$root/.worktrees/qwen35-gate-candidate-20261128"
cd "$p"
before=f314b8d5af16d49b2687f6f83f1b253e21a3d6eb
target=327904c559b9a91a24ee436da134811243a4d435
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$head" = "$before" -o "$head" = "$target"
if [ "$head" = "$before" ]; then
 git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/qwen35-gate-candidate-20261128
 test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target"
 git checkout --detach "$target"
fi
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
base=ai-core-model-gate:qwen35-candidate-f314b8d5
candidate=ai-core-model-gate:deepseek-candidate-327904c5
docker image inspect "$base" >/dev/null
docker build --network none --pull=false --build-arg GATE_BASE_IMAGE="$base" --target full-refresh -f Dockerfile.gate.refresh -t "$candidate" .
for f in compose.runtime.yml runtime/model-policy.yaml runtime/model_gate.py runtime/remote_model_gate.py; do
 expected="$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
 actual="$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" "/app/$f" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
 test "$expected" = "$actual"
done
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
echo DEEPSEEK_GATE_CANDIDATE_BUILD_SOURCE_TESTS=PASS
